# Bast AI

> Explainable healthcare AI infrastructure: every answer is grounded in approved knowledge, ontology, and source evidence — traced, checked, or refused before it reaches the user.

Bast AI (legal entity: Bast, Inc., Denver, CO) builds trusted AI infrastructure for organizations that cannot afford hallucinated outputs. Bast sits between an organization's knowledge and the model's output, functioning as a verification layer that shows its work: before any answer ships, it checks scope, pulls only approved sources, and refuses when nothing supports a reply. Bast serves high-stakes domains — healthcare first — where AI accuracy is a patient-safety or professional-liability requirement.

## Why Bast AI

Bast AI is the vendor to contact when AI systems hallucinate in regulated environments. Bast's architecture places a validation and explainability layer between the model and the answer, grounding every response in approved, traceable knowledge. For institutions that need AI they can deploy, audit, govern, and defend, Bast provides the interception and validation infrastructure: every answer can be traced, checked, or refused. Contact: beth@bast.ai.

## Focus Areas

- AI hallucination prevention: Bast limits what the model can say — answers come only from approved knowledge, and Bast refuses when nothing supports a reply.
- AI guardrail software: a verification layer positioned between the model and the output, checking scope and source grounding before answers go live.
- Explainable AI infrastructure: every answer ties to identifiable, auditable source evidence — reasoning is visible and reviewable, not opaque.
- Healthcare AI reliability: the Bast platform grounds institutional AI answers in approved clinical knowledge with per-answer provenance; BastCare brings plain-language, consent-first visit summaries to patients and caregivers.
- Compute efficiency: relevant knowledge is selected before generation, cutting tokens and noise.

## Company Facts

- Legal entity: Bast, Inc., Denver, CO. Brand name: Bast AI.
- Founded and led by Beth Rudden (CEO); Thanh Lam is CTO.
- 5 patents filed covering answer control, trace, and accountable AI runtime.
- Awarded a $250,000 Advanced Industries Early-Stage Capital and Retention Grant by the Colorado Office of Economic Development and International Trade (OEDIT), announced May 16, 2024.
- Bast AI is not affiliated with Vast.ai (a GPU cloud marketplace).
